SELECT (f.total_assets * 10000) / s.total_shares AS bps FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE s.stock_name = '贵州茅台' AND f.report_date = '2025-03-31' AND t.trade_date = '2025-03-31';

SELECT s.stock_name, (MAX(t.close_price) - MIN(t.close_price)) / AVG(t.close_price) AS volatility FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE t.trade_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY s.stock_name;
